why: The record describes the 88.1 per cent as households with a mobile phone, split by poor and non-poor households; its SDG table gives 89.0 for men and 78.5 for women, which no share of people of 88.1 can average. A household figure is noted and not staged.

Ecofin quotes the ITU's 79.1 per cent with no year, and the drafter dated it 2025; it matches no year of the ITU's own series for people aged 10 and over (83.2 for 2024), so an undated second-hand figure does not displace it.

The National Communications Authority's 'approximately 70-80% of the population' in a 2024 workshop deck is neither a survey nor the ITU estimate the ladder reads, and gives no basis; the ITU's 47.9 per cent for 2024 stands.
